concept.definition: An identifier assigned to a person for health purposes.
The number under which a person is insured for health care.
An identifier assigned to a person by a region.
An identifier of a region, such as the region that assigned a regional person identifier.

description: The identifier types the EEHRxF implementing act (Regulation (EU) 2025/327, Annex X, EHDSPatient.identifier.type and EHDSRelatedPerson.identifier.type) adds to the HL7 identifier type that the HL7 v2 table 0203 does not already define: health identifier, health insurance number, regional person identifier, and region identifier.
name: EhdsIdentifierType
title: EHDS identifier types beyond the HL7 identifier type
